_schema.description: Weekly desktop benchmark matrix for scripts/benchmarks/desktop-weekly/weekly.sh. Every family is a scripts/benchmarks/run-family.sh spec (see the _schema of scripts/benchmarks/families.json for cmake_target, bench_kind, binary, models, args, audio_duration_seconds and correctness) plus the fields below. Models are provisioned by fetch-models.sh before the run, so no family carries an S3 bucket or a HuggingFace source for the driver itself.

fields.task: Row group in the report: ASR, TTS, TTS cloning or Music.
fields.model_label: Human-readable model name for the report.
fields.runs: Timed iterations on a GPU backend.
fields.warmup: Untimed iterations before the timed ones on a GPU backend.
fields.cpu_runs: Timed iterations on the CPU backend (heavy generators get fewer).
fields.cpu_warmup: Untimed iterations on the CPU backend.
fields.timeout_minutes: Wall-clock cap for the whole family on one backend; the watchdog kills the driver past it.
fields.scenario: Optional input key for the report when the family does not use the task's default input: abcba for the 160.6 s multi-speaker clip (engines/parakeet/test/samples/abcba.wav, no reference transcript).
fields.engine: Optional engine name for a family that runs another engine beside QVAC (parakeet-mlx, mlx-whisper); absent means qvac-fabric-speech.cpp. Such a family names an absolute binary or ${BENCH_HOME}/... and lists no cmake_target.
fields.platform: Optional uname -s value (Darwin) the family needs; weekly.sh skips it elsewhere.
fields.backends: Optional list of backends the family runs on (metal); the weekly driver skips the other backends of the run.
fields.provision: How fetch-models.sh fills models/<family>/: {registry: <key under qvac_models_compiled/ggml/>}, {huggingface: {repo, revision, name, sha256?}}, {fixture: <repo-relative file>} or {derived: {name, kind: requantize|resample, source, type|rate, name_filter?}}. Registry, HuggingFace and derived files live once in models/store/ and are linked into every family directory that lists them. A registry or fixture entry may carry {as: <name>} to link the file into the family directory under another name (CosyVoice3 looks for voice.gguf).

parakeet-tdt.notes: 11 s JFK clip; WER against the checked-in transcript.

parakeet-unified.notes: 11 s JFK clip; WER against the checked-in transcript.

transcribepsy.notes: Published q8_0 GGUF from HuggingFace; 11 s JFK clip fits one window, so the 60 s long-form window is not exercised.

nemotron.notes: Offline decode of the 11 s JFK clip with the en-US locale prompt.

parakeet-eou.notes: 11 s JFK clip; WER against the checked-in transcript. The 2026-07-01 registry cut of the EOU model.

whisper-small.notes: Upstream whisper-cli on the 11 s JFK clip with 4 threads and no timestamps (-nt), so the stdout transcript is scored; process wall clock including model load.

parakeet-tdt-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER.

parakeet-mlx.notes: parakeet-mlx (MLX, Metal GPU only) on the same clip as parakeet-tdt, timed inside the process after one model load: log-mel plus encoder and decoder of one clip, bf16 compute. Needs the venv of README.md under <bench home>/mlx.

parakeet-mlx-abcba.notes: parakeet-mlx (MLX, Metal GPU only) on the same 160.6 s ABCBA clip as parakeet-tdt-abcba, timed inside the process after one model load: log-mel plus encoder and decoder of one clip, bf16 compute. Needs the venv of README.md under <bench home>/mlx.

mlx-whisper.notes: mlx-whisper (MLX, Metal GPU only) on the same clip as whisper-small, timed inside the process after one model load with greedy English decoding; the QVAC whisper-small rows are fresh-process timings, so the hub keeps the two in separate charts. Needs the venv of README.md under <bench home>/mlx.

mlx-whisper-abcba.notes: mlx-whisper (MLX, Metal GPU only) on the same 160.6 s ABCBA clip as whisper-small-abcba, timed inside the process after one model load with greedy English decoding; the QVAC whisper-small rows are fresh-process timings, so the hub keeps the two in separate charts. Needs the venv of README.md under <bench home>/mlx.

parakeet-unified-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER.

transcribepsy-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER. The clip exercises the 60 s long-form window.

nemotron-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER.

parakeet-eou-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER.

whisper-small-abcba.notes: 160.6 s multi-speaker ABCBA clip from the parakeet test samples; it has no reference transcript, so no WER. Process wall clock including model load.

supertonic3.weights: Q8_0, all components and voices in one GGUF
supertonic3.notes: Fixed English prompt; the last WAV is transcribed by pinned Whisper tiny on CPU outside the timed region.

chatterbox-turbo.notes: Built-in voice, fixed English prompt; process wall clock including model load; seed 42.

parler-mini.notes: Fixed English prompt with parler-bench's default description; sampled decoding at seed 42 because greedy decoding degenerates. The native bench times synthesis only.

parler-indic.notes: The Indic checkpoint on the shared English prompt (an Indic-script prompt could not be scored by the English reference ASR); sampled decoding at seed 42. The native bench times synthesis only.

audio8-lm-f16-dec-f16.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42.

audio8-lm-f16-dec-q8_0.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42.

audio8-lm-q8_0-dec-f16.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42.

audio8-lm-q8_0-dec-q8_0.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42. Same pair as the CI audio8-tts family.

audio8-lm-q4_0-dec-f16.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42. The Q4_0 LM is the 2026-10-28 registry cut.

audio8-lm-q4_0-dec-q8_0.notes: Process wall clock including model load; seed 42. The Q4_0 LM is the 2026-10-28 registry cut.

audio8-clone-enc-f16.weights: LM Q8_0, codec decoder Q8_0, codec encoder F16
args: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
audio8-clone-enc-f16.notes: Voice cloning from the 11 s JFK clip (resampled by the CLI); process wall clock including model load and reference encoding.

audio8-clone-enc-q8_0.weights: LM Q8_0, codec decoder Q8_0, codec encoder Q8_0
args: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
audio8-clone-enc-q8_0.notes: Voice cloning from the 11 s JFK clip (resampled by the CLI); process wall clock including model load and reference encoding.

moss-tts-f16.notes: 17 GB F16 backbone; process wall clock including model load. Needs about 21 GB of GPU or unified memory.

moss-tts-q8_0.weights: transformer blocks Q8_0 (rest F16), MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer decoder F16
moss-tts-q8_0.notes: The registry has no Q8_0 MOSS-TTS cut; fetch-models.sh requantizes the blk.* tensors of the F16 backbone with engines/tts/scripts/requantize-gguf.py.

moss-tts-clone-f16.weights: backbone F16, decoder F16, MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer encoder F16
moss-tts-clone-f16.notes: Voice cloning from the JFK clip resampled to the codec's 24 kHz; process wall clock including model load and reference encoding.

chatterbox-mtl-clone.weights: T3 MTL Q8_0, S3Gen MTL Q8_0
chatterbox-mtl-clone.notes: Voice cloning from the 11 s JFK clip (resampled by the engine); process wall clock including model load and reference encoding; seed 42.

cosyvoice3-clone.weights: LM Q8_0, flow F32, HiFT F32, speech tokenizer Q8_0, CAM++ F32
args: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
cosyvoice3-clone.notes: Zero-shot cloning from the 11 s JFK clip with its transcript as the prompt text; the native bench times synthesis only (model load and the reference encoding happen before the timed runs). The engine requires voice.gguf even when cloning, so the English baked voice is linked under that name.

acestep-turbo-q8_0.weights: DiT Q8_0; Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8_0, 5Hz LM 0.6B Q8_0, VAE BF16
args: An instrumental jazz trio with acoustic piano, upright bass and brushed drums.
acestep-turbo-q8_0.notes: 30 s render at seed 42; process wall clock including the load of all four stages.

acestep-turbo-q4_k_m.weights: DiT Q4_K_M; Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8_0, 5Hz LM 0.6B Q8_0, VAE BF16
args: An instrumental jazz trio with acoustic piano, upright bass and brushed drums.
acestep-turbo-q4_k_m.notes: 30 s render at seed 42; process wall clock including the load of all four stages.

acestep-sft-q8_0.weights: DiT Q8_0; Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8_0, 5Hz LM 0.6B Q8_0, VAE BF16
args: An instrumental jazz trio with acoustic piano, upright bass and brushed drums.
acestep-sft-q8_0.notes: 30 s render at seed 42 with the SFT DiT's default step count; process wall clock including the load of all four stages.

acestep-base-q4_k_m.weights: DiT Q4_K_M (no Q8_0 Base cut in the registry); Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8_0, 5Hz LM 0.6B Q8_0, VAE BF16
args: An instrumental jazz trio with acoustic piano, upright bass and brushed drums.
acestep-base-q4_k_m.notes: 30 s render at seed 42 with the Base DiT's default step count. The registry ships the Base DiT only as Q4_K_M, so this row is not like for like with the Q8_0 Turbo and SFT rows.
